records.part: Maintenance and repair of Automated Logic (ALC) HVAC control systems at City facilities
records.reason: the City entered into a three-year agreement with Control Air Enterprises, LLC (Control Air) for maintenance and repair of Automated Logic (ALC) HVAC control systems at City facilities
records.installed_location: City Hall, Public Works, Community Senior Center, and Library facilities

records.part: Installation of HVAC controls at the Pacific View Arts Center, integrating into City's existing controls system
records.reason: Control Air has proposed integrating the Pacific View HVAC system into the City’s existing controls.

records.part: Integration of generator and boiler into existing HVAC controls system for monitoring and alerts
records.reason: The system is in need of an upgrade to integrate the generator and boiler into the controls to provide an additional layer of monitoring and alerts for staff for any issues that may impact these two (2) critical components.

records.part: Replacement of non-operable and obsolete parts of existing HVAC control system to be compatible with current ALC system
records.reason: several parts of the existing system were discovered to be non-operable and obsolete

records.part: Unforeseen, as-needed repairs not covered under the standard maintenance agreement over the life of the agreement
records.reason: staff recommends adding $25,000 to the agreement not-to-exceed amount for unforeseen, as-needed repairs which are not covered under the standard maintenance agreement over the life of the agreement
